sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Hard work to talk. Headache; worse from
talking. Stupe lying headache in right side. Affections
of external head ; scaly eruption, white scabs. Head
covered with thick, leathery crusts, under which pus
collects. Violent neuralgia about face and teeth, run-
ning towards ear, at night; worse, eating; better, near
hot stove. Roots of teeth decay. Teeth feel elongated.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Sneezing, cor5'^za, interior of nose, ex-
coriated. Post-nasal adenoids.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Feel too much open, as if tympanum was
exposed to the cold air and it blew into the ear.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Ciliary neuralgia, after operations. Espe-
cially after removal of eyeball. Pains radiate and shoot
downward, ivith cold feeling and stiffness of bone. ’

sections.label: Face
sections.text: Red. Eruption around mouth, with coryza.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Desire for ham-fat. Burning in tongue,
extending to stomach. Mouth waters. Mausea felt in
throat; better, eating. Chronic gastritis; burning, cor-
roding pain; nausea, vomiting, chocolate color. Gastric
ulcer with much burning.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Swelling of glands with large abdomen
in children. Pressure in inguinal ring. Flatulent colic,
with shivering and difficult respiration.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Constipation after confinement. Pro-
lapse of rectum. Diarrhoea, with small, white particles.
Green discharges. Constipation, with hepatic and uterine
inertia. Constriction of anus; stitches and prolapse of

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Red flakes float on top of urine. Hot,
bloody. Biting, burning in forepart of urethra at the
close of micturition. Hsematuria preceded by cramp
pain in the bladder. After urinating, a few drops of
blood are passed.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too frequent, soon, profuse.
Leucorrhoea like albumen ; very corroding.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Enlargement of testicles. Violent sexual de-
sire. Gonorrhoea, with hsematuria.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Soreness and burning in bones of
thorax. Constriction across chest. Cough ; worse, eat-
ing, irritation lower than can be reached, on taking a
warm drink.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in neck and back; worse,
motion and at night; intolerant of all touch. Pain and
burning in tibia and long bones. Legs and feet go to

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Eczema; intolerable itching; chilliness with
pruritus ; worse in bed. Ulcers itch and burn, sur-
rounded by vesicles and shining, fiery-red areola. Zona,
with burning pain. Bones, especially long bones, in-
flamed and swollen ; caries, exostosis ; pain worse night,
touch, damp weather. [Merc.: Syph.} Eruptions ulcer-
ate and form thick scabs under which purulent matter
exudes.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, cold air ; night, evening until
midnight, warm food, touch, motion. Better, open air.

Induration of testes.

Syphilitic laryngeal ulcers in a tubercular patient. Hoarseness in

Pulse fast in the evening and night.

The principal use of this remedy is in eruptions and ulcerations.
The most violent and important of its symptoms are those of mucous
membranes, skin and periosteum. The outer surfaces of the body are
in a constant state of irritation ; nervous feelings, biting, tingling,
itching, changing place from scratching. Even when there is nothing
to be seen, there is violent itching and the patient rubs and scratches
until the part becomes raw and then burns ; itching changes place ; the.

As soon as he gets warm in bed or as soon as he goes into a warm

Vesicular eruptions upon the skin, running a certain course, itch-
ing, burning like fire ; dries into a crust and disappears ; a new crop
appears near or in the same place. Vesicles form crusts beneath
which is ulceration ; these crusts turn white, chalk-like, are thick,
tough, and leathery. They are often elevated ; fluctuation beneath the
crusts ; pressure causes thick, white pus, sometimes yellow-white, to
ooze forth ; violent itching. The pains are aggravated by cold, but
the itching and restlessness are worse from heat. A child tears at the
eruption with its fingers when the crusts are present.

Scald-head ; thick, white, elevated crusts ; copious, white or yellow-
white pus, often offensive, putrid ; vermin are often found among the
crusts. Acrid pus eating away the hair ; the eruption spreads to any
part of the scalp, especially to the top ; it is also found beneath the
ears, and about the face and chin.

Eruptions with much itching ; dark, red rash with violent itching,
biting, tingling, crawling, changing place by pressure, rubbing or
scratching. Cases with a history of suppressed eczema or syphilis.
Eruptions upon the legs and arms, on parts with poor circulation as
the ears, wrists, backs of the hands ; skin eruptions followed by ulcers ;
